summary: The RTL layout displays several bidirectional text and alignment defects, including punctuation jumping to line starts in English text, misplaced list bullets in ThoughtHeader, and inconsistent icon/spinner slotting in text fields.

issues.title: Misplaced step bullet markers in RTL
issues.description: Status bullets render at the end of first lines rather than as leading markers on the right edge.
issues.evidence: The bullet glyphs appear on the far right of the first text lines ('About •', 'three •', 'your •') instead of preceding the list items.
issues.suggestion: Position list bullets in a dedicated leading slot aligned to the start margin.

issues.title: BiDi punctuation jumping in RTL inputs
issues.description: English input text and helper copy without BiDi isolation causes punctuation and symbols to flip to opposite ends.
issues.evidence: Periods appear at line starts in helper text ('.How you appear') and textarea ('.component library'), and '@' renders at the trailing side in email fields.
issues.suggestion: Apply dir='auto' or unicode-bidi isolation to inputs and labels containing LTR strings.

issues.title: Asymmetrical spinner placement in text field
issues.description: Loading indicator in the work email field floats at the far-left edge rather than adhering to RTL trailing/leading icon padding.
issues.evidence: Spinner icon rests against the far left border while input text is right-aligned, leaving excessive empty space.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the spinner to the appropriate inline-end slot with consistent margin token spacing.
